notes.title: NIKE MARE 98 the official crossover of FEAR FA 98 × NIKE powered by TWITCH!
notes.content:
[p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45482293/cea4c992b0eb7f674d22db195524681e6f6cb6bf.png"][/img][/p][p][i]History is being made.

Introducing NIKE MARE 98 – the official spin-off and crossover of FEAR FA 98 × NIKE, powered by Twitch as part of Nike’s Scary Good campaign.[/i][/p][p][i]For the first time ever, Nike steps into the world of PC gaming.
For the first time ever, Twitch is directly involved in the production of a video game.
And for the first time ever, you’ll see the iconic logos of Nike and Twitch together inside a game.[/i][/p][p][i]⚡ An unprecedented collaboration.
⚡ A surreal fusion of sports, horror, and streaming culture.
⚡ A cultural milestone you didn’t know you were waiting for.

[/i][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45482293/c0ebe2fe2c93b45c05aecaa218fac28b0243bfd9.png"][/img][/p][p][i]This summer, the biggest Twitch streamers dove headfirst into the nightmare of NIKE MARE 98, bringing fear, competition, and hype to millions of viewers throughout July. Now it’s your turn.[/i][/p][p][i]🎮 Play it now, for FREE, on itch.io!
👉 [url="https://jacobjazz.itch.io/nike-mare-98"]https://jacobjazz.itch.io/nike-mare-98[/url][/i][/p][p][i]This is not just a crossover. This is a collision of worlds.
The pitch, the fear, the swoosh, the stream.
Welcome to NIKE MARE 98.

[/i][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45482293/58eaa6d1ed73ddbe81da02187de641dd81640916.gif"][/img][i]

[/i][b]A daring football reboot that’s too fast for logic… and too Scary Good to contain.[/b][/p][p][b]Every generation has a game that changes the rules. This game burns them.[/b][/p][p][b]From the haunted mind behind the cult horror-football classic FEAR FA 98 game by Jacob Jazz, and in collaboration with Nike Football and Twitch, comes a new kind of nightmare![/b][/p][p][b]NIKE-MARE 98 drags you into a twisted football underworld where instinct dominates, beauty misleads, and the pitch doesn’t play fair. You’ll step into the boots of cursed legends… not by name, but by nightmare. Because out here, it’s not about who you are. It’s about how terrifying your game is.
[/b][/p][h2][b]WELCOME TO THE HOME OF TERRIFYING SKILL 

We're here to reprogramme your game.

[/b][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45482293/077551abf5dfffd2f0ff2b7a04ec194e796cc546.gif"][/img][/h2]

notes.title: FEAR FA 98 at GDC with a new trailer!!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45482293/724af713f027a8a29a648824403b5edb619e87b0.jpg[/img]

FEAR FA 98 was showcased at various events during GDC 2025, such as the Future Games Show and The MIX!

[previewyoutube=VPteX-hRyy8;full][/previewyoutube]

It was a huge success! I traveled all the way to San Francisco to present the game!!. During the Future Games Show, the brand-new trailer for FEAR FA 98 was revealed exclusively, giving you a first look at the latest gameplay and spooky surprises.

notes.title: Silent Hill gets a soccer league in FEAR FA 98, and you can play the demo now
notes.content: My hometown has a soccer team now. I live in the United States, so this is kind of a big deal. It's been a cool experience to have a local team, and has led to some really interesting experiences, such as watching the lovely yet bizarre spectacle of internationally ranked goalkeeper Roman Bürki stalwartly defending the honor of my brand new hot pink midwestern American soccer team. When I see him bravely fighting in goal, a bunch of howling fans at his back, in Missouri for some reason, I am faced with one thought that outranks all others: give that man a gun... Read more.

notes.title: AI MUSIC REMOVED
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45482293/6920375522a179b0fbde1420e3a49c88ab801ecd.jpg[/img]

Even though many of you liked the main theme, I have decided to remove the AI-generated music since a large part of the players were requesting it. Thank you.

The main enemy in the game is an AI hidden within the sun. With that in mind, I decided to have some of the music (but not all) generated by AI. However, many players did not like this choice.

Therefore, even though many others did enjoy the tracks, I have decided to remove the AI-generated music and keep only the pieces I composed myself—except for the main theme, which was created by the artist Sara Lizeta.

Thank you all!
